bio.zh: 陈冰柔是一名时装与纺织品设计师，目前在读博士。她的创作关注材料本身，通过编织、封存等方式，把日常材料和传统工艺转化为新的穿着体验。
bio.en: Bingrou Chen is a fashion and textile designer and PhD student. Her practice centres on materials themselves, transforming everyday materials and traditional craft into new wearable experiences through techniques such as knitting and encapsulation.
